name: Uses Task Definition
description: An ECS task runs from a task definition revision, or an ECS service launches its tasks from one (task -> revision, service -> revision): the task's taskDefinitionArn, the service's taskDefinition. A revision is immutable, so a task's edge names exactly what it ran; a service's names the revision it launches now. The revision a running task names is collected even when it is deregistered (INACTIVE), so the edge does not dangle. A reference, not containment: a revision outlives the tasks that ran it.
